name: ClearPath
subtitle: Lumin AI by ClearPath, sideloaded and self-updating
description: Official ClearPath / Lumin AI source for AltStore and SideStore. Add this source once and updates show up here automatically -- no more manually redownloading and re-sideloading a fresh IPA every time.

apps.name: ClearPath Public Beta
apps.subtitle: Lumin AI: your academically-honest study companion
apps.localizedDescription: ClearPath is an educational platform built around Lumin AI, a study assistant that researches, explains and summarises -- and refuses to write your assignments for you. Includes tasks, grades, a calendar, class organisation and spaced-repetition flashcards.

versions.localizedDescription: Stability fix: v1.3/1.4 added a custom view controller that tried to resume the last-visited page on a fresh launch, but it caused the app to freeze on a blank launch screen in real-world testing. Reverted back to the stock Capacitor setup. The microphone permissions (v1.3) and the keyboard-covering-composer fix (v1.4) are unaffected and remain in place.

Fixed the on-screen keyboard covering the chat composer/input box. @capacitor/keyboard was configured with "resize: body", which only adjusts page CSS rather than actually resizing the webview -- switched to "resize: native" so the website's existing keyboard-avoidance logic (which already worked correctly in Safari) now works the same way inside the app.
Added microphone permissions so Lumin AI's voice-to-text works in the native app, not just the website.

Fixes native Google sign-in for real this time: Capacitor's iOS bridge wasn't registering the local sign-in plugin at all (a build-config gap, not a signing issue), so "Continue with Google" failed on every device regardless of how the app was sideloaded. It's registered correctly now.
Native Google sign-in (fixes consent-screen branding + adds an account picker) and a version bump so this build installs cleanly as a distinct update.

apps.name: Lumin Cal
apps.subtitle: A calendar that replaces Apple Calendar, with your study plan
apps.localizedDescription: Lumin Cal reads and edits your Apple Calendar events, adds your Lumin classes, due dates and AI study plan with a daily checklist, and includes a Today widget.

versions.localizedDescription: The widget now reads your Apple Calendar events itself, so they show even without shared storage.
The widget can now load your day from a link you paste into it (Edit Widget), so it works even when the app can not share storage with it.
Planner keyboard fix, Calendar tab no longer jumps to Today, Talk to Lumin now sends your plan as context, and Settings shows widget status.
A Plan tab: pick your dates, generate a study plan, tick blocks off (synced with the website) and talk to Lumin about any block.
New Week and Year views in the Calendar tab, and a Talk to Lumin button on every study task that opens a chat with the task already described.
Fixes the Today widget under SideStore, adds lock screen widgets, a new Up next card, progress ring, grouped checklist and colour-coded month dots. The app is now called Lumin Cal.
New glowing-calendar app icon. Also fixes the version mismatch error when updating.
Night-blue ClearPath look, a real app icon, and Sign in to Lumin so your classes, due dates and AI study plan show up next to your Apple Calendar.
First release: Apple Calendar read and write, study-plan checklist, month view and a Today widget.
